prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 93.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 87.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 74.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive Mascot Outfit Customizer Screen: Insert a new interactive accessory customization screen before adoption certificate so users can accessorize their pet before completing setup. (why: Adoption step drops to 74.4% and has a long median completion time (89s); giving an instant visual customizer increases emotional investment.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Interactive Playground Screen: Add an interactive desktop controls practice screen after home intro where users can test hiding, moving, and chatting with their pet. (why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% with 395s median time, and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide pets.)
2: [choose_path, copy] Preset vs Custom Path Explicit Distinction Copy: Update choose path headline and body text to clearly distinguish between instant companion selection and photo-based custom generation. (why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s, indicating confusion between instant and custom pet creation.)
3: [adoption, layout] Side-by-Side Pet Personality Preview Layout: Change pick_friend screen layout to a split view with live animation previews of pet personalities. (why: Adoption step has an 89s median duration and 74.4% conversion; visual side-by-side comparison speeds up selection.)
4: [home, wait_info] Audio Chime & Desktop Notification Waiting Alert: Add a subtle sound alert component and readiness badge on the waiting screen when generation completes. (why: Home waiting screen takes 201s median / 2336s mean, causing users to switch windows and abandon onboarding.)
5: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Personalization Account Sign-In Reorder: Reorder the sign-in step to occur after adoption certificate creation, so users complete pet personalization before creating an account. (why: Asking users to sign in before they personalize their pet creates friction early in the funnel.)

scores.note: Adoption loses 25.6% of users, but adding a new screen increases setup friction.
Both funnel (35.2% loss) and 3 support emails highlight control confusion at finish step.
Choose path already converts well (93.4%), though copy tweak reduces high mean duration.
Side-by-side preview speeds up decision-making on adoption step (74.4% conversion).
Re-engages users switching tabs during long generation wait (201s median).
Moving sign-in after personalization reduces early funnel friction.
